integration.title: MCP Integration
integration.description: Manage Model Context Protocol servers and tools

label: MCP
deleteMessage: Are you sure you want to delete {{name}}?
noServersFound: No servers found matching your criteria

market.loadFailed: Could not load the MCP market: {{detail}}
market.empty: No MCPs yet. Add one from a template.

group.globalHint: Available in every project: AionUi servers, extension servers and market MCPs attached globally.
group.projectEmpty: Nothing is attached to this project yet.

instance.writeNote: Write tier: it can change data outside this machine. Claude only, and every tool call asks first.

secret.clearConfirm: Clear this secret? The MCP cannot start without a required secret.
secret.writeOnlyHint: Write-only: the value is stored encrypted and never shown again.
secret.emptyValue: Enter a value, or use Clear to remove the stored one.

create.title: Add {{name}}
create.name: Name
create.nameRules: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; starts with a letter; at most {{max}} characters; unique. It becomes the tool prefix.

nameProblem.pattern: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.
nameProblem.notInMarket: This MCP is not offered in the market.
nameProblem.taken: An MCP with this name already exists.

create.duplicateNote: The copy gets the same template, environment, tier, CLIs, plain values and tool lists. Secrets are not copied: set them on the new MCP. It starts dormant.
create.readTierNote: Read: changes nothing outside this machine. Tools stay blocked until you allow them after a connection test.
create.writeTierNote: Write: can change production data, money, ads, email or public posts. Claude only; production write MCPs stay dormant until the owner's written approval is recorded.
create.dormantUntilComplete: It stays dormant until these are filled in: {{keys}}
create.startsDormant: New MCPs start dormant. Activate one when its values are set and the connection test passes.
create.secretsNotSaved: {{name}} was created, but these secrets were not saved: {{keys}}. Set them in the instance drawer.

attach.title: Attach {{name}}
attach.noInstances: No MCPs to attach. Add one from a template first.
attach.assistantNote: Applies to new conversations and idle team members only.
attach.notActiveNote: This MCP is not active: the attachment is saved, but nothing starts it until it is activated.

globalBlocked.notGlobal: Only context7 and studio-memory can be global.

conflict.otherChannel: {{cli}}: already reaches this project the other way (project files or an assistant, never both).

activate.title: Activate {{name}}?
activate.body: Active MCPs are started for the projects, assistants and CLIs they are attached to.
activate.missing: Fill in the required values first: {{keys}}
activate.productionWrite: This is a production write MCP. It stays dormant until the owner's written approval of the exact change is recorded.
activate.approvalHelp: written owner approval of the exact change
activate.approvalInvalid: Use the format OA-<yyyymmdd>-<slug>, for example a date and a short lowercase name.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.body: It stops being started at once and running copies stop at their next check. Attachments and secrets are kept, so it can be activated again.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: This removes the MCP, its attachments and its stored secrets. It cannot be undone.

dormant.title: Make {{name}} dormant?
dormant.body: It is no longer started anywhere until it is activated again. Nothing is deleted.

refresh.title: Update the template of {{name}}?
refresh.body: The MCP switches to the catalogue's current template. Secrets and attachments are kept; settings the new template no longer has are dropped.

template.notInCatalogue: This template is no longer in the catalogue; the MCP keeps running its stored copy.
template.pendingSecretsHint: Set these before updating; the MCP keeps its current template until then.

tools.allowHint: Read MCPs block every tool that is not ticked here (fail closed).
tools.blockHint: Ticked tools are blocked; Claude asks before every other tool call.
tools.none: No tools seen yet. Run Test connection to list them.

errors.maskedValue: A value shows as "•••" because it is hidden, not because it is the real value. Type the real value in again, then save.
errors.sessionRequired: MCP market changes need your signed-in browser session. Sign in again and retry; agents cannot make these changes.
errors.csrf: Your session's security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.catalogueUnavailable: The MCP template catalogue is not available right now.
errors.templateSecretMissing: Set {{keys}} first: the new template needs it. The MCP stays on its current template.
errors.notFound: This MCP or attachment no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.alreadyAttached: This MCP is already attached there for that CLI. {{detail}}
errors.nameTaken: That name is already used. Choose another name. {{detail}}
errors.conflict: This conflicts with the current state. {{detail}}
errors.templateSecretMissingUnknown: Set the secrets the new template needs first; the MCP stays on its current template. {{detail}}
errors.forbidden: This change is not allowed from here. Use your signed-in browser session.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.internal: The server hit an internal error. Try again; if it persists, check the AionUi logs.
errors.upstream: A service behind the server did not answer in time. Try again.
